topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: Satellite link budgets can be optimized by integrating dynamic resource allocation, advanced routing algorithms like QoS-OSPF with RSVP, and beamforming techniques using phased array antennas. This approach balances capacity allocation with latency constraints, mitigating interference and increasing spectral efficiency.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in satellite networks requires managing capacity and latency, with techniques like DVB-S2 and PCE enhancing link performance.
